question: Why was frames-100 selected cold bimodal (db10 IQR/median 0.417)?
page_cache_drop: posix_fadvise(DONTNEED) then mincore. Before the open the resident fraction was 0 on every trial, so the drop works.
cpu_frequency: No cpufreq governor or intel_pstate sysfs on this host. The TSC is constant (constant_tsc, nonstop_tsc), so the timer is not a frequency step.
open_readahead: After a cold open, mincore was the same 30 of 44 pages every time: the first 12 pages and the last 18, with pages 12 through 25 absent.
first_query: The timed query was the first touch of that hole. One-shot latencies on the identical bit pattern ran from about 0.10 ms to about 0.50 ms. The next query on the open store was about 0.02 ms.
fix: After the open and before the clock, the harness reads the missing pages. The selected cold query is then a resident read. n=12 median 4.75e-5 s, IQR/median 0.024.
cold_open: cold-open still times the open and the hole fault. That row stays wider.
